headline: Google signs nuclear power deal with Constellation
summary: Google signed a 20-year power purchase agreement with Constellation to upgrade six US nuclear power plant sites, adding turbines, generators and digital controls expected to unlock an additional 890MW of capacity for its data centers.

claims.statement: Google signed a 20-year deal with Constellation to upgrade six nuclear power plant sites in the US.

sources.quote: Google announced a new agreement to update six nuclear power plant sites across the US as the tech giant seeks to generate more electricity for its power-hungry data centers. Google signed the 20-year deal with Constellation, the leading nuclear power plant operator in the US.

claims.statement: Upgraded turbines, generators and digital controls are expected to unlock an additional 890MW of capacity.
